title: Decide whether the plain stale-descriptor federation test should stay strict (first retry 409) instead of following the retryable-503 contract
outcome: A recorded coordinator decision on whether federation_delivery_capability_stale_descriptor_is_not_retargeted_to_recreated_recipient keeps the bounded, invariant-checked contract retry for documented retryable 503s, or becomes strict again with the retry kept only in the scripted-outage variant.
acceptance: The coordinator records which behaviour the plain variant should have, citing the trade-off: strict detection of an unexplained load 503 versus following the documented intent-retry contract.
If the decision is strict, the plain variant asserts 409 on the first retry, the bounded retry stays only in the scripted-outage variant, and the module's tests pass.
disposal_reason: Decided, no change: the plain variant keeps its contract-following bounded retry (decision note, Fable2 03:17Z on 10-23).
